europe_now.title: Spanish National Election Context and Security Measures
europe_now.summary: Spain is holding a snap national election with immigration and political shifts serving as key issues amid preparations against potential foreign interference and cyber threats. Political figures have continued campaigning and making final visits ahead of the vote.

europe_now.title: Nationwide Demonstrations Across France Over Gender-Based Violence
europe_now.summary: Protesters have organized nationwide marches in France to demand stronger government action against gender-based violence and to highlight alarming safety statistics. Demonstrators explicitly criticized structural issues and policies surrounding femicides in the country.

sources.headline: France holds nationwide protests against violence towards women
Protesters against gender-based violence denounce 149 femicides in France

top_stories.title: French Economic Pressures and Credit Outlook
top_stories.summary: Credit rating agency S&P has signaled that it may downgrade France's credit rating due to ongoing financial and economic pressures. Financial stakeholders are closely monitoring these developments as national debt and budgetary concerns grow.

sources.headline: Credit rating agency S&P may downgrade France's credit rating

top_stories.title: Ukrainian Security and Defense Adaptation
top_stories.summary: Ukraine has implemented reporting restrictions regarding the impact of Russian strikes on critical infrastructure to protect operational security. Meanwhile, Ukrainian defensive capabilities continue to evolve, incorporating innovative technologies such as laser systems against aerial threats.
